name: Loading state
description: A pixel matrix that keeps time while the model has nothing to show yet.

name: Thinking indicator
description: A live status line that names what the agent is doing right now, with elapsed time.

name: Reasoning panel
description: A collapsible trace that streams reasoning steps along a timeline, then settles into a summary.

name: Streaming text
description: Tokens arrive softly: the newest words land in blue and settle into ink.

name: Typing indicator
description: The classic three dots, tuned to read as presence rather than noise.

name: Message pair
description: A user bubble and a streaming assistant reply, with actions that appear on hover.

name: Message branches
description: Navigate between regenerated versions of the same answer without losing your place.

name: Message actions
description: Copy, rate, and regenerate. Each action confirms itself with a small state change.

name: Follow-up suggestions
description: Prompt pills that stagger in after a reply and invite the next turn.

name: Error state
description: A quiet failure banner with a retry path, not a modal in your face.

name: Tool call
description: One tool invocation with its request and result tucked behind a disclosure.

name: Run activity
description: Ordered commentary and tools, with a live summary and a final answer that stays visible.

name: Tool timeline
description: A whole working session summarized as verbs, targets, and file stats.

name: Terminal block
description: Command output that streams line by line and ends with an exit status.

name: Code diff
description: A unified diff with tinted additions and removals, sized for chat.

name: Web search
description: A search query and its results landing one by one as the agent reads.

name: Sources (props-driven)
description: Citations collapsed into a pill, expanding into scannable source cards.

name: Inline citation
description: Numbered references inside a sentence, each with a hover preview of its source.

name: Link preview
description: A returned URL unfurled into a card with enough context to decide whether to open it.

name: Image generation
description: A dot grid holds the frame while the image resolves out of a blur.

name: Image gallery
description: A compact grid of returned images that opens each one in a shared lightbox.

name: Data table
description: A tool's rows and columns with formatting, sorting, and a card layout in narrow columns.

name: Number ticker
description: Digits that roll into place as a count updates in real time.

name: Agent plan
description: A checklist the agent works through, with progress you can glance.

name: Subagent list
description: Parallel workers with their own progress, models, and completions.

name: Agent status (props-driven)
description: One pill that always answers: what is it doing, and for how long.

name: Task card (props-driven)
description: A delegated task with its state, timing, result, and transcript in one card.

name: Approval card
description: Human in the loop: the agent asks before it runs anything with side effects.

name: Option list
description: The agent asks a question with a few answers; the pick returns to it and stays as a receipt.

name: Question flow
description: A few short questions asked one at a time, answered together and kept as a receipt.

name: Recommendation card
description: The agent proposes a change with its confidence, and waits for a yes.

name: Artifact card
description: A generated document as a tangible object, written live and versioned.

name: Composer
description: The unified input: attachments, commands, mentions, models, voice, and context in one surface.

name: Chat panel
description: The whole family working together: a message, a pause, a streamed reply.

name: Empty state
description: The first screen: a greeting, three ways in, and the composer front and center.

name: Thread list (props-driven)
description: Conversation history with unread marks and actions that wait for hover.

name: Scroll anchor
description: Streaming never steals your scroll position; a pill offers the way back down.

name: Conversation map (props-driven)
description: A rail of the whole thread: one tick per turn, the turn being read marked and the ones on screen deepened, and a hover preview of what it says.

name: Todo list
description: The agent's own working list, rewritten mid-run as it discovers what else is needed.

name: Message queue
description: Turns you typed while a run was in flight, stacked and cancelable until it finishes.

name: Attachments in a message
description: Files as received rather than staged: an image to open, a document with its page count.

name: Reviewable diff
description: The same diff, but each hunk is a decision: keep it, discard it, apply what survived.

name: File tree
description: Everything a run touched, as a tree, with the churn spelled out per file.

name: Elicitation form
description: A server pausing mid-tool-call to ask you for the fields it still needs.

name: Retrieval chunks
description: The passages a retrieval answer stands on, scored, before the answer itself arrives.

name: Chart
description: Area, line, and bars, with points landing one at a time as the series streams in.

name: Media player
description: Audio and video a tool returned, played inline without leaving the thread.

name: Trace waterfall
description: Every span in a run on one time axis, nested, so you can see where it actually went.

name: Canvas
description: The thread steps aside and the document takes the room, still being written as you read.

name: Voice conversation (props-driven)
description: A live call: the orb tracks your voice, the caption names the turn, the transcript follows.

name: Read aloud
description: An answer played back, the spoken word lit as it goes, speed under your thumb.

name: Server panel
description: Which servers are connected, what each one brought, and which is still waiting on you.

name: Feedback dialog
description: A thumbs-down that asks why, so the signal arrives with a reason attached.

name: Quote reply
description: Select a phrase in an answer and a toolbar offers to quote, explain, or rewrite it.

name: Edit a sent message
description: Rewrite a turn in place as a new branch, told up front how many replies stay behind on the old one.

name: Stopped run
description: You pressed stop. The half-written answer stays, and continuing is one tap away.

name: Timing footer (props-driven)
description: What the turn cost: time to first token, throughput, tokens, money.

name: Connection state
description: The socket drops, the run keeps going on the server, and the stream is picked back up.

name: Agent card
description: Who you are about to talk to: its skills, its model, and the endpoint behind it.

name: Web preview
description: Chrome for a sandboxed preview: a URL bar, reload, and open-in-new around a frame you isolate.

name: Draft restore
description: Come back to a thread and the sentence you never sent is still waiting.

name: Diagram
description: A drawn answer with zoom, reset, and a full-bleed view; you hand it the rendered graphic.

name: Flow graph
description: Work as a graph rather than a list: branches that fan out and rejoin.

name: Activity graph
description: A half-year of runs as a calendar of cells, dense where the work was.

name: Parallel tools (props-driven)
description: Calls that went out together, collapsed to one row until you want the detail.

name: Context breakdown
description: Where the window actually went: prompt, tools, files, conversation, and what's left.

name: Model picker
description: The full list rather than the rail: grouped by family, priced, with what each one can do.

name: Reasoning effort
description: How hard to think, and how much of that budget the run actually spent.

name: Guardrail notice
description: A refusal in its own shape, with the nearest thing it can do instead.

name: Timestamps
description: Chronology in a long thread: days marked, times on hover.

name: Speaker identity
description: Who is talking, once a thread holds more than a user and one model.

name: Regenerate with
description: Fork the same turn to a different model instead of rolling the same dice.

name: Confidence
description: Which claims came from a source, which were inferred, and which are guesses.

name: Tool failure
description: One call failed. The error, the attempt count, and a retry that doesn't restart the turn.

name: Permission grant
description: Granting a capability rather than approving one action, with the reach spelled out.

name: Computer use
description: The screen the agent is driving, with a cursor trail and what it is doing right now.

name: Code runner
description: A snippet with a run button, and the output it produced attached below it.

name: Document reference
description: A document the answer leans on, with the quoted passage and the page to jump to.

name: Memory
description: What it now remembers about you, written during the turn and removable.

name: Research report
description: An outline that fills in section by section, each carrying the sources behind it.

name: Map
description: A location answer: pins, a route between them, and the list they came from.

name: Geo map
description: Places and routes on a real tiled map, with an accessible list of every place.

name: Math
description: Rendered expressions with the working shown, one step at a time.

name: Spec sheet
description: The most common structured answer after a table: one object, labeled.

name: Comparison
description: Two options weighed side by side, with the pick named and argued.

name: Timeline
description: Events on a time axis, with what already happened and what is still coming.

name: Long job
description: Work measured in minutes: weighted stages, an ETA, and a way out.

name: Score breakdown
description: A verdict with its arithmetic shown: criteria, weights, and what pulled it down.

name: Cost meter
description: What the run spent, split by model, against the session total.

name: Quota
description: How much is left, when it comes back, and the way to get more.

name: Handoff
description: Control passing between agents, with the reason and what came along.

name: Background runs
description: Work still going somewhere else, and the results waiting to be collected.

name: Checkpoints
description: Points you can fall back to, with what each one would give back.

name: Schedule
description: A run that repeats on its own, with its cadence and how it has been doing.

name: Prompt library
description: Prompts you saved, searchable, with their variables shown before you insert one.

name: Command palette
description: Everything the app can do, one keystroke away and grouped by where it acts.

name: Shared conversation
description: A read-only transcript someone sent you, with a way to pick it up yourself.

name: Search in conversation
description: Find inside a long thread, with every hit marked down the scrollbar.

name: Thread search
description: History you can actually get back into: pinned first, then grouped by when.

name: Launcher
description: The floating entry point, and the panel it opens into.

name: Settings
description: Model, system prompt, temperature, and what the assistant is allowed to do.

name: Onboarding
description: First run: three moves that teach what this assistant is actually for.

name: Mobile composer
description: The bottom sheet: keyboard-aware, quick actions above, thumb-sized targets.

name: Eve Ask Question
description: Renders Eve's built-in ask_question tool as a standalone question with answer controls, outside the collapsed tool group.

name: Thread
description: Chat container with message list, composer, auto scroll, and accessibility built in.

name: Voice Orb (props-driven)
description: The props-driven voice orb: five session states and four palettes, no runtime required.

name: Context Display Core (props-driven)
description: The props-driven context usage display: ring, bar, and text presets with the usage popover, no runtime required.

name: Voice
description: Realtime voice session controls with connect, mute, and a status indicator.

name: Voice conversation
description: The live call screen bound to the thread's voice session: orb, caption, transcript, mute, and end call.

name: Task card
description: A runtime task card with nested transcripts, timing, results, and grouped task lanes.

name: Agent status
description: A runtime task summary chip with an optional tray for every task in the thread.

name: Markdown Text
description: Render assistant markdown with headings, lists, links, and code blocks.

name: Reasoning
description: Collapsible panel for assistant reasoning and thinking content.

name: Conversation Map
description: Runtime-backed thread rail: a tick per turn, the turn being read marked and the ones on screen deepened, a hover preview, and a click that scrolls there.

name: Reasoning Panel (props-driven)
description: The props-driven reasoning disclosure: streaming preview, fades, and variants, no runtime required.

name: Message Timing
description: Badge with streaming stats: time to first token, total time, and tokens per second.

name: Context Display
description: Token usage against a model's context window as a ring, bar, or text, with a hover popover.

name: Thread List
description: Sidebar or dropdown for switching conversations, with search and active selection.

name: MCP Config Dialog
description: Dialog listing MCP connectors and custom servers, with OAuth and bearer auth controls.

name: Attachment
description: Attach files from the composer and view them inside messages.

name: Follow Up Suggestions
description: Prompt chips rendered from runtime generated follow up suggestions.

name: Tooltip Icon Button
description: Icon button with an accessible tooltip label, shared across the assistant UI components.

name: Syntax Highlighter
description: Code block highlighting powered by react-syntax-highlighter.

name: Assistant Modal
description: Floating chat bubble for support widgets and help desks, with a thread list and a resizable window.

name: Assistant Sidebar
description: Side panel chat for copilot experiences and inline assistance.

name: Tool Fallback
description: Default renderer for tool calls that have no dedicated UI.

name: Tool Group
description: Collapsible wrapper around consecutive tool calls.

name: Shiki Highlighter
description: Code block highlighting powered by react-shiki.

name: Shiki Highlighter (props-driven)
description: The props-driven Shiki code block: streaming-aware highlighting, no runtime required.

name: Mermaid Diagram
description: Render Mermaid diagrams in messages, including while they stream.

name: Mermaid Diagram (props-driven)
description: The props-driven Mermaid renderer: zoom overlay, skeleton, and error fallback, no runtime required.

name: Diff Viewer
description: Render code diffs with highlighted additions and deletions.

name: Thread List Sidebar
description: Sidebar shell that hosts the thread list beside a thread.

name: Quote
description: Select and quote message text with a floating toolbar and a composer preview.

name: Sources
description: Display URL sources with favicon, title, and an external link.

name: Image
description: Display image parts with preview, loading states, and a fullscreen dialog.

name: File
description: Display file parts with icon, name, size, and a download button, playing audio and video inline.

name: Model Selector
description: Model picker with reasoning effort levels, search, and runtime integration.

name: Model Selector (props-driven)
description: The props-driven model picker: search, groups, and reasoning effort levels, no runtime required.

name: Dot Matrix
description: 5x5 dot matrix indicator with state specific blink patterns.

name: Number Roll
description: Animated number that rolls its digits odometer style when the value changes.

name: Heat Graph
description: Activity heat map with month and weekday labels.

name: Composer Trigger Popover
description: Character triggered picker for @ mentions, / commands, and similar popovers.

name: Directive Text
description: Render mention directives as inline chips in user messages.

name: Directive Text (props-driven)
description: The props-driven directive chip renderer: bring your own formatter, no runtime required.

name: Generative Markdown
description: Render streamed Markdown and nested generative UI content.

name: Generative UI
description: Styled component library for rendering generative UI output.
